cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The Agent workflow declares 109 step operations, but the UI can call only model runs (POST /runs), a few data operations and statistical exploration. There is no HTTP route that executes a workflow step without the Agent; the CLI calls WorkflowExecutor directly. Reports can only be created through the AI report route.
impact: User requirement 2026-10-08: every function must work in Workbench alone without a model, and the Agent calls the same functions. Objective step 3 (operation catalog and generated forms) and the manual report in step 8 depend on three interfaces requested from the v1-8-13 line as a contract commit; steps 1, 2 and the independent parts of 4-9 proceed meanwhile.
lesson: An Agent capability with no direct route is a feature the user cannot reach without a model; give every operation one declared execution path and let both the UI and the Agent call it.

cause: Objective step 1: one tokens file (theme/tokens.css) for light and dark; colour literals and undefined colour variables removed; contrast held by test.
impact: Measurement fixed before reporting the drop: CSS colour literals 176 -> 0, TS colour literals 96 -> 0 (52 were in the unused lineage/tokens/tokens.ts, deleted), undefined colour variables 27 -> 0, inline styles 934 (ceiling). The BACKLOG figure of 139 could not be reproduced and is superseded. Browser audit at 1512x982: 0 contrast failures on eight surfaces in light and dark; first pass found four (role badges, React Flow attribution, Ask AI button, bottom panel log text) and they were fixed. V1811-DARK-PANEL-CONTRAST resolved.
lesson: Fallback values in var() hide undefined tokens; forbid colour fallbacks and require every var() to be defined in the tokens file.

cause: Objective step 2: the workspace shell behind a switch with results-first and lineage-first layouts, spring switching, divider snapping, per-project memory, Agent folding and the bottom panel.
impact: Browser acceptance at 1512x982: 280 to 772 px in about 350 ms with no long task, mid-flight reversal starts from the interpolated value, divider release snaps and persists, wide views borrow the wide stage, contrast audit 0 failures in both themes on five views. WorkbenchRouteContainer 2101 to 2098 lines.
lesson: Let the old shell keep owning state and hand its pieces to the new layout as slots; both shells then share one source of truth while the new one is behind its switch.

cause: The contrast audit ran while the browser pane was hidden; CSS transitions do not advance there, so a theme switch left segmented controls at their light background and the audit reported 1.12 for selected items in dark.
impact: One false finding investigated; no product change. The audit script now finishes finite animations first and skips hidden elements.
lesson: Before measuring computed colours or sizes in a possibly hidden page, finish running transitions or the readings are their start values.

cause: First open-time measurement put the new shell at 1.60x the classic one; it included Vite compiling the new modules on first request. Warm runs measured 1.00x and 0.93x.
impact: Open-time budget is not yet established on a production build; step 10 measures it against v1.8.12 with vite build.
lesson: Compare page timings only after a warm-up run, and settle budgets on production builds.

cause: User review after step 2: project home and launcher kept the classic tabs and chrome; the stage could not be closed and covered the map; the overall result was judged far from acceptable.
impact: Stage now opens with what is open and folds away; the narrow map is a card tree; wide views start without a map; home, start page and launcher use the workspace top bar; a model step leads with its result (estimate, interval, coefficients, fit, checks); plain buttons are quiet; the Agent column reads as a conversation. Also: v1.8.13 was not started (user quota), so the operation-catalog interfaces are not available.
lesson: Placing old pieces into new regions is not a redesign; each region needs content designed for its size (a tree for a 280px map, a result view for the stage) before the user sees it.

cause: User review 2: keep the light/auto/dark switch and gear settings button; no way back from project home to the analysis; difference between New project and New analysis unclear; New project dialog overflowed the screen; Agent composer needs a full redesign; the search button did nothing.
impact: Theme switch and gear restored; Home is a view tab; search opens through an explicit event and works on home; the dialog is portalled; the Agent column has its own composer without dead controls; New analysis has a tooltip.

cause: The new top bar uses backdrop-filter; that makes it the containing block for position:fixed descendants, so the create-project dialog opened from the project menu was laid out inside the 48 px bar and clipped.
impact: Dialog rendered into document.body with a portal.
lesson: Overlays that must cover the window render through a portal; filters, transforms and backdrop-filters on an ancestor capture fixed positioning.

cause: The search button dispatched a synthetic Cmd+K, and project home did not mount the search palette at all, so the button did nothing there.
impact: Palette listens for an explicit open event and is mounted on home in the workspace; a selection made from home switches to Analysis.

cause: User review 3: Data view controls misaligned and unexplained; top bar shifted between Home and other views; node page chart unexplained, borderless controls, floating panel not resizable, collapse button wrong; manual report unreadable; Agent lost unsent text, live response covered the panel, reasoning duplicated the reply, no message actions or times, global turn timed out.
impact: All review-3 items addressed in five commits; numbers in manual reports are now bound to evidence by value markers; Agent sessions gained rewind, fork and chapters on the existing append-only session tree. Nothing merged, pushed or tagged; full gate not rerun.
lesson: A timeout reported by a person is evidence to read from the session log before changing anything; here the log showed a whole-turn budget, not a network failure.

cause: Frozen-pack options with closed vocabularies (alternative, method, missing_policy, trend, ...) were served as free text with nullable, so manual users guessed spellings and explicit null reached the kernel as the string None.
impact: Resolved in efd535ba: one vocabulary table built from contract constants that the kernels also import; enums served, null no longer advertised; 904 pack/catalog and 937 agent/workflow tests pass; Analyze shows a choice in the browser.
lesson: A served option vocabulary must be the object the kernel validates against, not a copy of it.

cause: Re-review of the v1.6.2 (Hermes) and v1.8.11 (Claude Code) evaluation lists left four items worth doing in v1.9.0: categorical-term quoting in dropped-variable checks (P2-13), unbounded local/gate runs, an inline-style ceiling that did not follow reductions, and no CLI path to the operation catalog.
impact: Resolved in 80644771, 1454a581, 449a60e3, c0e23c71: quote_column used for C() terms (5 quoting cases tested); gate keeps the newest 3 passed runs and every failed/running/pinned one; ceiling 934 -> 856 and must equal the count; `workbench analyze list|describe|run|confirm` reaches every workflow operation through the manual preview/confirm service, and closed-schema refusals now name the failing path and allowed values.
lesson: A ratchet that only fails on increases lets savings silently erode; make it fail on decreases too, so the ceiling follows the count.

cause: Every visit parsed one 1,653 kB chunk (507 kB gzip) including xlsx, the graph engine and every view; RunForm and six other modules plus 41 CSS classes were kept alive only by their own tests since v1.8.6.
impact: Resolved in 29a46fe8, 83172332, f8ed0671, 35c39f2f: launcher loads 205 kB (67 kB gzip), routes/views/xlsx on demand, no chunk over 500 kB, total JS unchanged; ~2,700 lines removed. bundleBoundaries, cssUsage and moduleUsage tests keep each from regressing; 242 files / 1,920 vitest pass.
lesson: A module or style kept alive only by its own test is dead; check reachability from the app, not from the test suite.

cause: The manual report draft carries every computed value (1,862 facts for the step-1 OLS run); each keystroke re-rendered one checkbox per fact with an O(n) includes() inside a collapsed section.
impact: Resolved in 854413bb: 6,153 -> 566 DOM nodes; 173 ms -> ~20 ms per keystroke (dev build, median of 21, same harness A/B), unchanged with the list open.
lesson: Measure input latency with the real run's evidence size; a fixture with three facts hides quadratic renders.

cause: Data-oracle script runs wrote a new oracle-* directory per script under tests/fixtures/script_export/local_runs with no pruning (1,048 directories, 169 MB in six days); a categorical result-contract test lived at backend/.../categorical/tests.py, a name pytest never collects.
impact: Resolved in 5b21dfde and b8155d08: oracle runs use the managed local/test-evidence root (newest 3 sessions, failed kept), guarded by test_evidence_writers_use_the_managed_root; the categorical test moved to tests/ and passes. Existing 169 MB left for the user to decide.
lesson: Evidence writers and test files are found by scanning, not by remembering: grep for mkdtemp under tests/fixtures and def test_ under backend/.

cause: Profiled honest_rm (R-matching event test, 61 s): 86,439 linprog calls; HiGHS itself 7.9 s, scipy's per-call wrapper the rest (option validation alone 11.5 s builds a HighsOptionsManager per option). The algorithm is a line-for-line port of R HonestDiD and was not changed.
impact: Open: a faithful fast path needs the public highspy package (reused solver, identical options, bitwise equivalence test against linprog on the fixture LPs) and is a dependency decision for the user. Test-side, identical engine/adapter runs are now computed once (8fd1d457, ~23 s per full run).
lesson: Profile before optimising a numerically validated port: here the solver is fast and the wrapper is not, so the fix belongs at the call boundary, not in the algorithm.

cause: User review 4: view tabs not level with the actions outside Home; right-click Ask AI gone; Agent answers about itself weak (provider 'environment', no context window, refuses to describe its instructions).
impact: Resolved in 75047f96, 6f770c1b, 0c13e0f3: below ~1512 px the action group had wrapped to a second line (row 84 px) - now one line; 'Ask AI about this node' had only opened the node detail since the Agent column replaced the drawer box - now selects the node and fills the composer, plus a right-click menu for selected text; identity names the provider by host, states a declared context window, and says what persists. Measured at 1512/1440/1280 px in the browser.
lesson: Test layouts below the design width: 1512 px fit by 3 px, so any narrower window broke the row.

cause: The Agent context builder reads 'compaction' entries but nothing writes them, so every turn resends the whole conversation; a long enough conversation will exceed the model's context window. The main Agent also has no long-term memory (domain memory is wired to the Notebook only) and no per-project instructions file.
impact: Open, for the user to prioritise: conversation compaction, a project instructions file, and main-Agent memory are each a feature, not a fix.
lesson: A reader for a record type nothing writes is a feature that does not exist; check for the writer.

cause: The Agent resent its whole conversation every step (nothing wrote compaction entries), had no way to receive standing conventions, forgot earlier conversations of the same project, and wrote/re-read its whole event log for every streamed delta (23 ms each on a 2 MB log).
impact: Resolved in 8ebbfda0, d272fdea, e453ebfc, bb07218b, 976174b3 after pi/Codex/Hermes: statistics-aware compaction (summary numbers checked against what they replace; unverified summaries excluded from evidence), overflow compact-and-retry, manual summarize; built-in analysis guide + personal + project AGENTS.md; project-scoped conversation recall instead of global memory; event emit 0.08 ms. Real DeepSeek run on a copy of the acceptance project: 100,539 -> 25,073 estimated tokens in 9.7 s, summary verified. Frontend 1,930 and Agent backend 1,180+ tests pass. Closes the open compaction gap of 2026-10-14.
lesson: In a statistics agent a compaction summary is evidence for later answers; check its numbers the way replies are checked.

cause: User review 5: Agent conversations were fixed to their node or page, with no way to start a new one, switch, delete, archive or rename. The binding lived in per-tab sessionStorage keyed by run and context fingerprint, so closing the tab or a context change lost track of a conversation that was still on disk.
impact: Resolved in d2a38960 and the frontend commit after it: GET/PATCH/DELETE /agent/conversations; picker in the Agent header with search, switch, rename, archive/restore, confirmed delete; new conversation; binding in localStorage with one-time carry-over. Delete keeps the analysis ledger, proposals and records and is refused while a turn runs or while a fork continues from the conversation. 5 backend and 4 picker tests; frontend 1,934 pass; real project shows its 5 conversations.
lesson: Anything a person creates needs a way to find, name and remove it; storage keyed by an internal fingerprint is not a place a person can find.
